                cache_position is None
                or (cache_position is not None and cache_position[0] == 0)
                or self.rope_deltas is None
            ):
                delta0 = (1 - attention_mask).sum(dim=-1).unsqueeze(1)
                position_ids, rope_deltas = self.get_rope_index(
                    attention_mask,
                )
                rope_deltas = rope_deltas - delta0
                self.rope_deltas = rope_deltas
            else:
                batch_size, seq_length = input_ids.shape
                delta = cache_position[0] + self.rope_deltas if cache_position is not None else 0
                position_ids = torch.arange(seq_length, device=input_ids.device)
                position_ids = position_ids.view(1, -1).expand(batch_size, -1)
                position_ids = position_ids.add(delta)
                position_ids = position_ids.unsqueeze(0).expand(3, -1, -1)

methods.name: Qwen3ASRThinkerForConditionalGeneration.get_audio_features
methods.signature: (self, input_features: torch.FloatTensor, feature_attention_mask: Optional[torch.LongTensor]=None, audio_feature_lengths: Optional[torch.LongTensor]=None)

excerpts.source:
if feature_attention_mask is not None:
            audio_feature_lengths = torch.sum(feature_attention_mask, dim=1)
        else:
            audio_feature_lengths = None
        feature_lens = audio_feature_lengths if audio_feature_lengths is not None else feature_attention_mask.sum(-1)
    
        # audio encoder do not support batch inference to keep precision
        audio_features = []
        for input_feature, feature_len in zip(input_features, feature_lens):
            audio_output = self.audio_tower(
                input_feature[:, :feature_len],
                feature_lens=feature_len.unsqueeze(0),
            )
            audio_feature = audio_output.last_hidden_state
            audio_features.append(audio_feature)
        audio_features = torch.cat(audio_features, dim=0)

position_ids = attention_mask.float().cumsum(-1) - 1
        position_ids.masked_fill_(attention_mask == 0, 1)
        position_ids = position_ids.unsqueeze(0).expand(3, -1, -1).to(attention_mask.device)
        max_position_ids = position_ids.max(0, keepdim=False)[0].max(-1, keepdim=True)[0]
        mrope_position_deltas = max_position_ids + 1 - torch.sum(attention_mask, dim=-1, keepdim=True)

        return position_ids, mrope_position_deltas

    Should be overridden by all subclasses.

    .. note::
        Although the recipe for forward pass needs to be defined within
        this function, one should call the :class:`Module` instance afterwards
        instead of this since the former takes care of running the
        registered hooks while the latter silently ignores them.

purpose: Read-only installed official source investigation; no model construction, GPU work, weight hashing or implementation changes.

teacher_forcing.attention_mask: original text mask followed by len(Y)-1 ones
teacher_forcing.rope: Set thinker.rope_deltas=None before each trajectory and explicitly pass no KV/cache_position. Official cache_position=None branch recomputes self.rope_deltas; passing rope_deltas=None alone is not the reset mechanism.
teacher_forcing.audio: Reuse original input_features and feature_attention_mask unchanged. Full forward reinjects/re-encodes audio; no generation KV or precomputed audio cache is reused.

probability_notes: GenerationMixin clones final logits into FP32, calls processors, then optionally retains both tuples. Returned raw_logits may alias in-place-mutated processor input in general.

All three frozen captures have zero logits processors; require that to remain true. Under this gate, raw and postprocessor logits must be identical, so official output_logits/output_scores are sufficient without adding a processor.
Calculate probabilities/log-probabilities from original FP32 rows with logsumexp; EOS mass sums unique effective EOS IDs. BF16 archives and FP32 archives have different I/O budgets.
Cached generation and full-sequence teacher forcing can differ numerically; compare and report rather than claim bitwise equality.
Word CULINARY is multiple tokens: initial [34,1094,32593], later [356,1094,32593]. Base correct first token34 is shared with loop; compare candidates only under the same token prefix.

size_estimates_bytes.note: Array payload only; excludes model weights/activations/KV cache, serialized metadata, filesystem overhead and derived summaries. No full softmax probability matrices need be archived.
